change.title: pr-4
change.description: FEATURE: Embeddable Discourse comments, now with simple-rss instead of feedzirra
change.author: Robin Ward

findings.title: raw_html posts publish unsanitized remote HTML as `cooked`
findings.body: With `cook_method == raw_html`, `cook` returns `raw` as is. That skips the sanitizer that normal cooking applies. The raw text comes from outside the forum: `poll_feed.rb:35` HTML-unescapes the feed body, and `TopicEmbed.import_remote` (`topic_embed.rb:48-50`) keeps `a[href]` and `img[src]` without checking the scheme, so `href="javascript:..."` gets through. The result is shown on the forum's own origin, both in the normal topic view and through `raw post.cooked` in `app/views/embed/best.html.erb:19`. If the embedded site or its feed is compromised, or if it shows user-supplied content (like its own comments, which Readability may pick up), that becomes stored XSS on the forum. Run raw_html content through a whitelist sanitizer before storing it, or in `cook`.

findings.title: Anonymous requests can create unlimited topics by changing the embed_url
findings.body: The only checks on `best` are that the `Referer` header's host equals `embeddable_host` (line 26), which a non-browser client sets freely, and that `embed_url`'s host matches (`topic_retriever.rb:15`). The throttle key is the full URL (`topic_retriever.rb:26`). `TopicEmbed` matches on the exact string (`topic_embed.rb:15`, `:79`). So `http://host/post?x=1`, `?x=2`, `#a` and so on are each throttle-free and each creates a new topic, posted as `embed_by_username`, from any anonymous caller. Normalise `embed_url` (drop the query and fragment, or canonicalise it) before the lookup, the throttle and the import. Also consider a throttle that limits the requester, not only the URL.

findings.title: `<%- end if %>` is a stray modifier `if`
findings.body: `end if` with nothing after it is not a valid way to close the block. Erubis appends `;` after statement code, which makes this `end if ;`, and that should fail to compile: every embed of an existing topic would return 500. If the compiler joins it with the next line instead, the trailing `if` silently takes the next output statement as its condition. The controller spec doesn't render views, so it can't catch either case. This should be `<%- end %>`.

findings.title: Items without `content:encoded` crash the whole poll, and with it embed retrieval
findings.body: `i.content` is nil for plain RSS 2.0 items that only have `<description>`, and `nil.scrub` raises NoMethodError. That stops the loop, so none of the remaining items are imported. Separately, `TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve` calls `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` inline (`topic_retriever.rb:41`). The exception therefore also kills the retrieve job before `fetch_http` runs, so with such a feed no embed is ever created and the loading page keeps reloading. Fall back to `i.description` when content is missing, and rescue errors per item.

findings.title: Disqus import no longer keeps the thread date or category, and aborts on one bad link
findings.body: The old call passed `created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at])` and `category: category_id`. `TopicEmbed.import_remote` takes neither, so every imported topic gets today's date and lands uncategorized, and the `--category` option is gone with no replacement. `import_remote` also fetches every thread's link over HTTP (`topic_embed.rb:48`) with no rescue: one dead or 404 link raises `OpenURI::HTTPError` and stops the whole import in the middle.

findings.title: The origin check is a substring match
findings.body: `discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1` accepts any origin that is a prefix or substring of `discourseUrl`. For example, `http://forum.example.co` passes when `discourseUrl` is `http://forum.example.com/`. The only harm today is resizing the iframe, but comparing the origin exactly (scheme, host and port parsed from `discourseUrl`) is the safe check.

findings.title: `setnx` followed by a separate `expire` can leave a permanent throttle
findings.body: If the process dies between `setnx` and `expire`, the key never expires, and that URL is never retrieved again for non-staff users. `SET key 1 NX EX 60` does both in one atomic step.

findings.title: The 30s reload can hit the 1-minute anonymous cache
findings.body: `best` calls `discourse_expires_in 1.minute`, which puts anonymous responses into `Middleware::AnonymousCache` (`application_controller.rb:168-170`). The reload 30 seconds later can get the cached 'Loading' page even after the topic has been created, so anonymous readers wait up to another 30s. The page also reloads forever if retrieval keeps failing. Consider not caching the loading response, and capping the number of reloads.

findings.title: An existing migration was edited to add `force: true`
findings.body: This migration has already been released, so the edit only changes behaviour on fresh databases. There, `force: true` silently drops an existing `top_topics` table. The edit seems unrelated to embedding. `create_topic_embeds` uses `force: true` too, for no clear reason.

findings.title: The test name says 404, but the request fails earlier, in ensure_embeddable
findings.body: With no `embeddable_host` stubbed, the `ensure_embeddable` before_filter raises InvalidAccess before `params.require(:embed_url)` runs. The test therefore passes without ever exercising the missing-parameter path. Stub a valid host and referer so it actually checks what its name says.

contracts.action: GET embed/best enqueues RetrieveTopic for unknown URLs
contracts.equivalent_path: Jobs.enqueue runs inline when queue_jobs? is false, otherwise via Sidekiq
contracts.before_after: Only the referer header and embed_url host are checked; the throttle is per exact URL
contracts.visible_effect: The loading page is rendered and reloads every 30s
contracts.failure_mode: If the job fails (feed error, fetch error, missing user), the page reloads forever with no error; distinct URLs bypass the throttle and create topics

contracts.action: Remote fetches in import_remote and poll_feed: what bounds the wait
contracts.before_after: The new open() calls pass no timeout, and RetrieveTopic runs PollFeed and then fetch_http one after the other
contracts.visible_effect: The user sees the loading page until both finish
contracts.failure_mode: Bounded only by open-uri defaults (the read timeout is 60s per call, with no open-timeout limit); the job can hang for a long time

contracts.action: PostCreator sets cook_method before the post is saved
contracts.equivalent_path: Post before_save cooks only when it is not a new record
contracts.before_after: cook_method is set during setup_post, before save_post
contracts.visible_effect: cooked equals raw for imported posts

summary: The embedding feature works on the main path, but it has two security problems, one likely template error, and a few regressions. The security problems: raw_html posts publish unsanitized remote HTML on the forum's own origin, and anyone can create unlimited topics by varying the embed URL, because the only gates are a Referer header and a per-URL throttle. The template: `end if` in best.html.erb probably breaks every embed of an existing topic, and the specs don't render views, so they can't catch it. The regressions: poll_feed crashes on RSS items without content:encoded, which also blocks embed retrieval, and the Disqus import now loses thread dates and categories. The rest are suggestions.
